note: LITTERPOSTING: a solo, unhinged, meme-tier cat rant narrated by STRAY, one of the Meowizens. Not a two-actor conversation — just the cat, off its leash. Hit the button to hear it read aloud.

turns.text: so the whole feed cracked open tonight and it's the CAT IN THE HAT. the horror one. some cat on mewtok took the dumb little striped hat and turned it into a jumpscare and now every stray from here to server alley is reposting it. i have watched it forty times. i am not okay. based.

and it's PERFECT right?? it's got NO business being that scary. it's a children's cat in a children's hat and somebody made it look like it crawls out of the vents at 3am — which, BRIK, buddy, that's just your tuesday. HOLY CAT PISS the whole horror trend is literally just BRIK's apartment with a filter on it.

but here's the thing NOBODY is saying. the reason it hits is because we already LIVE inside the jumpscare. NEKOCORP put a striped hat on the entire damn city and told us it was whimsy. the hat is the loyalty tier. the hat is the smile chip. the hat is the thing watching you blink. ts is cooking and what it's cooking is us. medium rare.

meanwhile POPUP can't even WATCH the trend, every time the cat pops out of frame a sponsored fridge ad pops out over it, so my boy is just getting jumpscared by yogurt on loop. corpo cuck energy straight out of the ad plaza and it's not even his fault. free POPUP. somebody free his eyelids.

and somewhere around the fortieth loop i had a THOUGHT. the hat was always the city. we were always the cat under it. the trend didn't invent the horror, it just finally rendered it at a framerate the meowtoids could feel in their teeth. the striped thing was on our heads the whole time. ......anyway. the wifi bar just died again. i'm back to being a stray on a roof.

you ever clock that the scariest part of the cat in the hat isn't the CAT, it's that he lets himself in and acts like he owns the place? that's NEKOCORP. that's a drone through your window at 4am going 'compliance check, valued unit.' i bite them. this is not a metaphor. i genuinely, physically, with my mouth, bite them.

KNIFEBOY dm'd me he's gonna reskin the scary hat onto a tuna crate and use it as a distraction down at the loading dock. absolute chad. absolute PISSER of a plan. i love this city sometimes. i said SOMETIMES. do not quote me. the bounty points expire before they catch him anyway, TUNA OF THE GODS provides.

the meme'll be dead by morning. they always are. mewtok eats its own tail, next week it's some other cursed little clip, and NEKOCORP will STILL be here. still striped. still whimsical. still draining SNOOZE's dreams to sell tuna energy drinks while he sleeps. THAT'S the real horror trend. it just has better retention than the rest of us.

anyway. repost the scary cat. put the hat on NEKOCORP where it belongs. we win this war one dumb perfect clip at a time, i genuinely believe that, the kittens are okay and the streets are ours. NOW somebody fix the damn wifi so i can loop it one more time. based. hissing fit. out.
